description:
Marine and weather warnings in force for a point, from every official
    source at once — gale and storm warnings (BMS Météo-France, AEMET, MeteoAM,
    Met Office) plus European MeteoAlarm warnings resolved to the actual region,
    not the whole country.

    Empty list means no warning is in force, which is a real answer worth
    stating. Each warning carries its issuing service, validity window, level
    and the official text in the publishing language.

    Check this before any passage or coastal activity. Costs no third-party call
    when warm (own 15-minute cache).
name: get_zone_alerts
title: Marine warnings in force
